items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: I believe if I'm mistaken, I believe that's the one who taught George how to play and his brother.

ctx.x: Do you remember, did his father play some instrument or was he in the band?

Old Man Barquet. Yeah, he used to play clarinet, Old Man Barquet. Old Man Barquet. If I'm mistaken, of course I was very young. I believe if I'm mistaken, I believe that's the one who taught George how to play and his brother. Of course you couldn't tell now, Achille Barquet and George Barquet, well, that's the old man who used to play clarinet too. Now, of course they used to have a band by the name of Alexander, but I ain't talking about that young fella now. He's paralyzed. He's got a stroke, I believe. But…
I've seen his picture. He's playing off the horn right there.
